title: Signed cubic prime ideal reduction
objective: Implement and differentially validate PARI 2.17.4 signed cubic prime ideal reduction for exponents -3..3 with compact ordered principal factors and exact T2 reduction

handoff.summary: Implemented the restricted PARI 2.17.4 cubic pr_inv_p and post-T2 idealred0 tail in ordinary source-transparent Python. Exact inverse-prime initialization, cubic inverse solve/denominator recovery, compact ordered principal factors, scalar/content handling, and PARI gexpo branch selection replay identically in CPython, JavaScript, and GMP. A pinned totally-real-cubic fixture checks all signed idealpow controls from -3 through 3 and independently replays HNF(J*principal(F))=HNF(P^e).
risks: T2 candidate selection remains an explicit input boundary; this lane does not claim the existing LLL graph is wired into the wrapper.
Generic ideal multiplication, binary intermediate reduction, arbitrary matrix-ideal inversion, and genback remain later integration work.

architecture:check reaches optimizer opportunity verification but detects its shared generated manifest as stale after adding this source-transparent kernel; the integration lane owns that shared refresh.
next_steps: Wire existing G*I and ranked-LLL machinery to provide the candidate buffer without changing this exact arithmetic contract.
Implement the extended-ideal multiply/square and negative inversion schedule, using the frozen -3 control to ensure binary intermediate reductions are preserved.
Refresh shared optimizer opportunity artifacts after integration, then rerun architecture:check and the broader native suite.
